hook.name: LendingHookV2
hook.description: A V4-native multi-tick lending AMM from the lo0p protocol that seeds a LOOP/ETH pool with single-sided LOOP positions across discrete bands. Intercepts swaps only to record lastSwapBlock (enforcing a same-block borrow lockout); users can borrow ETH against LOOP collateral, with band-aware liquidation that routes ETH proceeds back into the originating band.
